clauses.text:
Executive Other,
Mr. Arthur S. Blum may be reinstated as photogr-apher- in the Forest
Service, Washington, D. C., without regard to the length of his separation
from the service.
The Civil Service Commission joins the Secretary of Agriculture in
recommending this order because of the unfair treatment received by Mr.
Blumn through the misstatements of his superior officer, wvho has since been
adjudged insane. 
WM H TAFT
THE WHITnE HOUSE,
Jutne S, 1912.
'No. 1542.1
